description: Header file defining Vulkan JSON serialization/deserialization structures and functions for Vulkan device, instance, and extension properties, including classes, methods, and external references.

classes.name: VkJsonLayer
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan layer with properties and extensions.

classes.name: VkJsonExtDriverProperties
classes.description: Holds driver properties with reporting status.

classes.name: VkJsonExtVariablePointerFeatures
classes.description: Holds variable pointer features with reporting status.

classes.name: VkJsonExtShaderFloat16Int8Features
classes.description: Holds shader float16 and int8 features with reporting status.

classes.name: VkJsonCore12
classes.description: Contains Vulkan 1.2 core properties and features.

classes.name: VkJsonCore13
classes.description: Contains Vulkan 1.3 core properties and features.

classes.name: VkJsonDevice
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan device with properties, features, extensions, and various Vulkan-specific data.

classes.name: VkJsonDeviceGroup
classes.description: Represents a group of Vulkan devices.

classes.name: VkJsonInstance
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan instance with layers, extensions, devices, and device groups.

methods.name: VkJsonGetInstance
methods.description: Returns a VkJsonInstance object representing the current Vulkan instance.

methods.name: VkJsonGetDevice
methods.description: Returns VkJsonDevice for a given VkPhysicalDevice.
